pandas.read_csv

pandas 3.1.1 · Input and output · function

Parse delimited text into a DataFrame. Use dtype for identifier columns and usecols or chunksize to limit the data read.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

Call syntax

pd.read_csv(…) Full signature
pd.read_csv(
    filepath_or_buffer,
    *,
    sep=…,
    delimiter=…,
    header='infer',
    names=…,
    index_col=None,
    usecols=None,
    dtype=None,
    engine=None,
    converters=None,
    true_values=None,
    false_values=None,
    skipinitialspace=False,
    skiprows=None,
    skipfooter=0,
    nrows=None,
    na_values=None,
    keep_default_na=True,
    na_filter=True,
    skip_blank_lines=True,
    parse_dates=None,
    date_format=None,
    dayfirst=False,
    cache_dates=True,
    iterator=False,
    chunksize=None,
    compression='infer',
    thousands=None,
    decimal='.',
    lineterminator=None,
    quotechar='"',
    quoting=0,
    doublequote=True,
    escapechar=None,
    comment=None,
    encoding=None,
    encoding_errors='strict',
    dialect=None,
    on_bad_lines='error',
    low_memory=True,
    memory_map=False,
    float_precision=None,
    storage_options=None,
    dtype_backend=…,
)

Parameters
ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
filepath_or_buffer
      Required
Positional or keyword		
      str, path object or file-like object
Pass a path, a URL, or an open file-like object such as StringIO.


sep
      Optional
Keyword only		
      str
Choose the field separator. The usual default is a comma. Use sep="\t" for tab-delimited text.


delimiter
      Optional
Keyword only		
      str
Alternative name for sep. Supply one of these arguments.


header
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'infer'		
      int, Sequence of int, 'infer' or None
Use "infer" for the usual header behavior, None for absent headers, or zero-based row positions for header rows.


names
      Optional
Keyword only		
      Sequence of Hashable
Supply explicit names for labels, fields, or levels.


index_col
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      Hashable, Sequence of Hashable or False
Identify the column or columns whose values should become the row index.


usecols
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      Sequence of Hashable or Callable
Pass selected names, integer positions, or a callable that accepts each column name.


dtype
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      dtype or dict of {Hashable : dtype}
Pass a dtype for all columns or a mapping such as {"id": "string"} to preserve identifiers with leading zeroes.


engine
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      {'c', 'python', 'pyarrow'}
Choose "c", "python", or "pyarrow". Features differ between these parsers.


converters
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      dict of {Hashable : Callable}
Map column labels or positions to conversion functions.


true_values
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      list
Add source values that should become boolean True.


false_values
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      list
Add source values that should become boolean False.


skipinitialspace
      Optional
Keyword only
Default False		
      bool
Set True to ignore spaces immediately after delimiters.


skiprows
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      int, list of int or Callable
Skip selected input rows before creating the DataFrame.


skipfooter
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 0		
      int
Skip this many lines at the end of the input.


nrows
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      int
Limit the number of rows to read or display.


na_values
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      Hashable, Iterable of Hashable or dict of {Hashable : Iterable}
Choose additional missing markers for all fields or supply a dictionary of markers by column.


keep_default_na
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool
Choose whether pandas' built-in missing strings are recognized along with custom markers.


na_filter
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool
Set False to turn off recognition of empty fields and other NA markers.


skip_blank_lines
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool
Skip empty lines when True. With False, those lines can produce rows with missing values.


parse_dates
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      bool, None, list of Hashable
A list of column labels chooses columns to parse. True primarily attempts to parse the index.


date_format
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str or dict of column -> format
Specify datetime parsing or formatting directives such as "%Y-%m-%d".


dayfirst
      Optional
Keyword only
Default False		
      bool
Prefer the day before the month when interpreting ambiguous date text.


cache_dates
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool
Reuse parsed dates when source values repeat.


iterator
      Optional
Keyword only
Default False		
      bool
Set True to get a TextFileReader for incremental reading.


chunksize
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      int
Set a positive integer to get a TextFileReader that yields batches.


compression
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'infer'		
      str or dict
Choose whether and how to compress or decompress data.


thousands
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str (length 1)
Identify the character separating groups of digits.


decimal
      Optional
Keyword only
Default '.'		
      str (length 1)
Identify the character used as the decimal mark.


lineterminator
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str (length 1)
Specify the character or string ending each record.


quotechar
      Optional
Keyword only
Default '"'		
      str (length 1)
Specify the character used to quote a delimited field.


quoting
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 0		
      {0, 1, 2, 3}
Choose a quoting rule using the csv module's quoting constants.


doublequote
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool
Choose whether doubled quote characters denote a single quote inside a field.


escapechar
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str (length 1)
Specify the character that escapes an otherwise special character.


comment
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str (length 1)
Identify the comment character used when parsing text.


encoding
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str
Name a text encoding such as "utf-8".


encoding_errors
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'strict'		
      str
Choose how to handle text that cannot be encoded or decoded.


dialect
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      str or csv.Dialect
Supply a CSV dialect object or a registered dialect name to configure delimiters and quoting together.


on_bad_lines
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'error'		
      {'error', 'warn', 'skip'} or Callable
Choose "error", "warn", "skip", or a callable supported by the selected engine.


low_memory
      Optional
Keyword only
Default True		
      bool
Allow the C parser to process the file in chunks internally. The result still contains all requested rows unless chunksize or iterator is set.


memory_map
      Optional
Keyword only
Default False		
      bool
Use memory mapping for an eligible file path.


float_precision
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      {'high', 'legacy', 'round_trip'}
Choose the floating-point converter for the C engine.


storage_options
      Optional
Keyword only
Default None		
      dict
Pass storage-backend options such as connection settings or HTTP headers.


dtype_backend
      Optional
Keyword only		
      {'numpy_nullable', 'pyarrow'}
Choose nullable NumPy-backed dtypes or Arrow-backed dtypes.

    
Returns
DataFrame for a full read. TextFileReader when chunksize or iterator requests incremental reading.
